description:
At the age of thirty, with a special mission. Live well as someone who is no longer anything.

Once a highly regarded swimmer and a bit of an outlier, Yeongmin is now as ordinary as anyone else.

It seems like everyone else's life is going well except for mine...

Meeting her childhood friends 'Seongyeon' and 'Doha' by chance, Yeongmin is reminded of the confident and radiant Yeongmin of the past and us.

As people in their late twenties and early thirties, they face the ordinary concerns of everyday life and unravel past events while Yeongmin seeks to break free from self-pity and find true love.
